% Shared LaTeX scaffolding for slide figures. DO NOT edit per-figure.
% Renders one tikzpicture on a real 16:9 beamer frame using this repo's own
% preamble.tex and princeton theme, so the preview IS the slide layout -- same
% fonts, same colors, same usable area as the deck the figure ships in.
% Drive it through build_figure.sh, which sets \figfile and TEXINPUTS for you.
%
%   pdflatex "\def\figfile{myfigure.tex}\input{main.tex}"
%
% Deliberately NOT a standalone document: a slide figure is \input into a frame,
% not \includegraphics'd, so every package, TikZ library, and color it uses must
% come from preamble.tex. Loading the same preamble here means a figure that
% previews cleanly cannot fail in the real deck build.
\input{preamble.tex}

% Frame title for the preview. build_figure.sh overrides it with -t.
\providecommand{\figtitle}{Figure Preview}

\begin{document}

% Titled frame, matching the common case. The body area below the title is
% 14.9cm x 6.2cm -- if the figure overflows it, pdflatex reports an
% "Overfull \vbox" and the preview shows the figure running off the slide.
\begin{frame}{\figtitle}
    \centering
    \input{\figfile}
\end{frame}

\end{document}
